feeds.title: Hair & Makeup for Weddings Blog
feeds.description: Frankie Rose is a well established wedding makeup artist working in and around Warwickshire. Modern and elegant styles for your special day. She has worked with hundreds of brides and covers Buckinghamshire, The Cotswolds and Hertfordshire.

feeds.title: Rocky Mountain Bride » Wedding Hair & Makeup
feeds.description: Browse the best hair stylists and makeup artists in the Rocky Mountains for your wedding day, engagement photos, or elopement! Rocky Mountain Bride is a small but mighty team of women who are able to call the beautiful Rocky Mountains home. We love what we do and even more so, we love that love is what has brought you here!

feeds.title: Dreamcatcher Artistry Blog
feeds.description: We are your beauty dream team made up of exceptionally talented artists, who love what we do! Founded in 2011 by Leah Gilbertson, our company quickly flourished into a highly sought-after team. With incredibly genuine, caring, and engaging artists, we've built a community based on beauty from the inside and out.

feeds.title: Houston Bridal Makeup Blog
feeds.description: Hey there! I'm Sam, Polished company founder, and lead artist. Together with my team, I love making clients look and feel gorgeous, confident, and simply amazing. We promise to pamper you with our hair and airbrush makeup services to help elevate your confidence and beauty. Get an inside look at our best bridal beauty tips and tricks, hair and makeup inspirations, and what's in our makeup kit.

feeds.title: Captivating Beauty Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Tracy! I'm the proud owner of Captivating Beauty. I have been in the wedding industry for over 12 years. As well as being the owner of this amazing company and partnering with our team of creatives. I'm also a wife of 37 years, mom of 3 boys, 3 beautiful daughter-in-loves, and grandma to 7 grandchildren.

feeds.title: Junebug Weddings Blog » Beauty Hair Makeup
feeds.description: Find the best makeup artists, hairstylists, photographers, planners, venues, and wedding professionals worldwide. Junebug Weddings is the essential guide to planning a stylish wedding. Hi, I'm Sara Rogers - a global adventurer and a wedding and portrait photographer based in Vancouver, BC, and shooting celebrations locally and Worldwide.

feeds.title: Mountain Bridal Artistry Blog
feeds.description: Rachael is a Colorado Native who is passionate about blending her enthusiasm for hair + beauty with her modern and on-trend aesthetic. Today, as the owner of Mountain Bridal Artistry and a successful local salon for over a decade, she's focused on supporting her teams and clients.

feeds.title: Bridal Express Blog
feeds.description: Bridal Express has been in business for over 12 years and is a premier Bridal Hair and Makeup service in Las Vegas. All of our expert hair and make-up artists are licensed and have years of experience. We have helped over 5,000 brides get ready for their special day! We would love to hear from you, we really do have a passion for bridal hair and makeup.

feeds.title: Simple Beauty Artistry Blog
feeds.description: Based in the Houston area, Simple Beauty Artistry provides an exceptional bridal hair and makeup team to bring out your inner beauty. Our highly skilled team is available to travel internationally, interstate, or locally, and we can readily accommodate a party of any size. We are here to provide you with a picture-perfect result.

feeds.title: Priscilla M Beauty Blog
feeds.description: Consider us your beauty bestie, we are here to help alleviate any stress that might come with booking your makeup and hair team. From the moment you reach out to your event day, you will experience firsthand what amazing customer service feels like. Our goal on your big day is for you to have a seamless, fun, and relaxing experience.

feeds.title: Luxy Hair Blog » Wedding
feeds.description: Find expert tips from celebrity hairstylists, hair care advice, trending hairstyles, hair inspiration, wedding hair ideas, and much more. We're committed to giving you the total package: exceptional customer support, transparency, and confidence. Our mission is to help women look and feel beautiful every day. Because we are.

feeds.title: Calon Bridal Hair Blog
feeds.description: My name is Alaw. I was bought up in Carmarthenshire and have worked in some of the leading hair salons across South West Wales. I began my wedding industry journey when I got married in 2012 and then moved to Gower shortly after. I enjoy designing timeless hairstyles for brides and bridesmaids whilst providing a friendly and professional service.
